liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Eyes Of The World** (2 reviews): Reviewer likes the Eyes into China Doll, apart from a few flubs; Reviewer calls Eyes incredible [16][18]
- **Let Me Sing Your Blues Away** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls it a poorly sung, badly played group effort, though the band redeems itself right after; Reviewer says Jerry and Bob seem unsure what to play throughout this song [16][17]
- **Row Jimmy Row** (1 review): Reviewer calls this Row Jimmy beautiful, with Jerry's playing very articulate [12]
- **Weather Report Suite** (1 review): Reviewer describes Weather Report Suite as new and excellent [13]
- **Let It Grow** (1 review): Reviewer calls Let It Grow incredible [18]
- **Greatest Story Ever Told** (1 review): Reviewer found Greatest Story a treat [13]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): Reviewer describes China Cat into Rider as smooth and tasty [16]

## Setlist highlights

- **Roll Out The Barrel and other ditties**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [21]
- **another busted string**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [21]
- **Let Me Sing Your Blues Away**: rare: 8 archived performances [21]
- Earliest performances in the archive: Row Jimmy Row [21]

## The recordings

- **gd1973-09-08.mtx.tobin.126079.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 29 songs; 211 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd73-09-08.sbd.wulf.183.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 28 songs; 189 min; rated 4.52/5 by 31 [7]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says Billy and Bobby lock into a tight groove, with slow tempo but simmering tension; Reviewer describes a relaxed groove with good sound quality [10][17]
- **gd1973-09-08.sbd.goodbear.78349.flac16**: soundboard; 29 songs; 193 min; rated 3.62/5 by 8 [8]
- **gd1973-09-08.upg-sbd.tobin.126071.flac16**: soundboard; 29 songs; 211 min [2]

## Around the show

- Reviewer's first live Dead show; security had been especially harsh the night before, leaving the crowd jumpy [13]
- Night before saw many possession busts, reportedly including off-duty NYPD; Gov. Rockefeller was pushing a tough-on-drugs image, making the scene tense [15]
- Band's energy and solid groove eased the tension; a huge Skull and Roses banner towered over the stage [15]
- Reviewer saw Dark Star Orchestra play this show's first set at Irving Plaza in NYC [18]
- The show fell on Pigpen's birthday, the first since his death the previous spring [20]
- Reviewer ranks this show among their top 10 for 1973 despite an unspectacular-looking setlist [10]
- Reviewer says the energy matches anything else from 1973, though the show is overlooked because of its ordinary setlist [9]
- Reviewer suggests this show and the previous night together would make a great release [12]
- Reviewer says the Sept. 11 Weather Report Suite is better than this one, and Eyes lacks the energy of other 1973 versions [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1973-09-08.mtx.tobin.126079.flac16**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: Matrix 2 Source Mix - SBD (shnid=183) SBD> master reel> cassette> Dat >HD> shn; transfer by T. Wul + AUD (shn id 126070) source: aud cassette master; taped by… [1]. Also: Matrix mix made by an archive.org user, converted to FLAC in November 2013; Trader Little Helper credited [1]
- **gd73-09-08.sbd.wulf.183.sbefail.shnf**: source: Soundboard [7]
- **gd1973-09-08.sbd.goodbear.78349.flac16**: transferred by Goodbear; source: Sbd, Reel M->Cass 1->Dat 0->DAT 1->CD->FLAC, [8]. Also: Chain runs reel, cassette, DAT, then 1999 edit without hiss reduction, CD, Cool Edit Pro hiss edit, FLAC; not widely circulated source [8]
- **gd1973-09-08.upg-sbd.tobin.126071.flac16**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: SBD> master reel> cassette> Dat >HD> shn; transfer by T. Wulf:(original shn 183) - pitch correction and patches by Kevin Tobin [2]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by johnsdeadart.blogspot.com: [John's Custom Grateful Dead Album Cover Art](https://johnsdeadart.blogspot.com/2017/05/blog-post_36.html) [22]
